iip3_policy: declared unsupported; measured post-sizing as an ADVISORY column via kaggle/loop/verify.py; NOT gated.

specs.name: cap-e01-wifi
specs.notes: Loosest WiFi-band target: everything relaxed one step below wifi24. The sanity floor -- if the loop cannot clear this, nothing downstream matters.

specs.name: cap-e02-gpsband
specs.notes: GPS band, all-loose. gps-l1 relaxed hard (NF 1.8->3.5, S21 15->10, Idd 3->15): tests band handling without the noise-first squeeze.

specs.name: cap-e03-900mhz
specs.notes: 900 MHz ISM, all-loose. Lowest band on the ladder; larger spirals (l_max 15 nH like gps-l1).

specs.name: cap-e04-35ghz
specs.notes: 3.5 GHz, loose. Interpolated wifi/ism band with a mild S21 bump to 12.

specs.name: cap-e05-ism58
specs.notes: 5.8 GHz, loose. ism58 band with NF/S21/Idd all relaxed -- isolates the high-band matching difficulty from the tight-spec difficulty.

specs.name: cap-e06-wifi
specs.notes: WiFi, mild. One notch tighter than e01 toward wifi24's real numbers (NF 3.0, S11 -10, S21 12).

specs.name: cap-e07-gpsband
specs.notes: GPS band, mild. Halfway between e02 and the real gps-l1 squeeze.

specs.name: cap-e08-wideband
specs.notes: Wideband 0.5-3 GHz, loosest. Reuses the wideband screen (allow_inductorless, band-wide S11/ripple) at relaxed thresholds; the inductorless-class sanity floor.

specs.name: cap-m01-wifi
specs.notes: wifi24 exactly (NF 2.5, S11 -10, S21 12, Idd 5). The reference commercial target as a mid-tier rung.

specs.name: cap-m02-gpsband
specs.notes: GPS-ish, noise-leaning but not the full 1.8 dB squeeze. Between gps-l1 and wifi24.

specs.name: cap-m03-900mhz
specs.notes: 900 MHz commercial: WiFi-class NF with a bit more gain at the low band.

specs.name: cap-m04-35ghz
specs.notes: 3.5 GHz commercial. NF eased slightly vs 2.4 GHz (higher band), tighter match (-11).

specs.name: cap-m05-ism58
specs.notes: ism58 exactly (NF 3.5, S11 -10, S21 12, Idd 10). The real 5.8 GHz experimental-transfer target as a mid rung.

specs.name: cap-m06-wifi
specs.notes: WiFi, tighter match + gain. Pushes S11 to -12 and S21 to 15 while holding NF near wifi24.

specs.name: cap-m07-gpsband
specs.notes: GPS, noise-first mid. NF 2.0 (approaching gps-l1's 1.8), gain 15, low power 4 mA.

specs.name: cap-m08-ism58
specs.notes: 5.8 GHz commercial-tight. ism58's band with NF eased to 3.0 but match tightened to -11 and gain to 14 -- a second high-band mid rung distinct from m05, so the M tier still spans all five narrowband centres.

specs.name: cap-h01-wifi
specs.notes: WiFi, tight. Low NF (1.8) + tight match (-13) + high gain (16) + low power (4) simultaneously.

specs.name: cap-h02-gpsband
specs.notes: gps-l1 tightened: its NF 1.8 / Idd 3 kept, but S11 -12 and S21 16 added -- the noise-first target with a match+gain squeeze on top.

specs.name: cap-h03-900mhz
specs.notes: 900 MHz, tight. Lowest NF at the low band with high gain and low power.

specs.name: cap-h04-35ghz
specs.notes: 3.5 GHz, tight. Tight match (-14) at a mid-high band with low NF.

specs.name: cap-h05-ism58
specs.notes: 5.8 GHz TIGHT (brief-required). ism58's band with NF 2.0, S11 -13, S21 16, Idd 5 -- high-band matching difficulty stacked with a tight spec.

specs.name: cap-h06-wifi
specs.notes: WiFi, hardest narrowband. NF 1.5 (the floor of the NF axis) + S11 -15 (the floor of the match axis) + S21 18 at once.

specs.name: cap-h07-gpsband
specs.notes: GPS, extreme. NF 1.5 + S21 20 (the top of the gain axis) + Idd 3 -- the corner where noise, gain and power all bind.

specs.name: cap-h08-wideband
specs.notes: Wideband TIGHT with band-wide S11 (brief-required). 0.5-3 GHz, s11_max_db -15 across the whole band, ripple 1.5, NF 2.5, gain 16, 5 mA -- the inductorless hard corner.
